title: CmdPal: Fluent, theme-aware host config for Adaptive Cards

proposed_comments.title: Preserve edited file-path inputs across a theme refresh

confidence.rationale: Exact-head tracing connects actual-theme refresh, updater reset, custom-control reconstruction from element.Value, and TextChanged/browse handlers that never update that parsed value. No runtime reproduction is claimed.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve edited file-path inputs across a theme refresh

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Controls/ContentFormControl.xaml.cs` (`RefreshHostConfig`), `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.AdaptiveCards.IncrementalRendering/IncrementalAdaptiveCardUpdater.cs` (`ResetCore`), and `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Controls/AdaptiveCards/AdaptiveFilePathInputElement.cs` (`AdaptiveFilePathInputControl`).

**Problem:** An actual light/dark theme change rebuilds an open form from the same parsed card after clearing its rendered root and incremental snapshot. The custom `Input.CommandPalette.FilePath` control initializes its replacement text box from `element.Value`, while editing or browsing changes only the old text box's `Text`. Consequently, an edited path is replaced with the original parsed value. The reference-equality guard avoids unchanged configurations; it does not preserve input state when the theme really changes.

**Why it matters:** A user can lose an unsaved file-path edit when the form's theme changes, then submit the original path instead of the path they selected. This concerns transient form data, not deletion of a file.

**Suggested change:**
1. Capture live file-path input values by input ID before replacing the rendered controls, rather than relying on the original parsed `Value`.
2. Coordinate that state transfer with the form refresh and renderer/input lifecycle so the replacement uses the edited value without submitting the form or requiring inputs to pass submit-time validation.
3. Keep the new host configuration and theme colors, preserve the unchanged-config guard, and ensure the restored value is also what a later submit reads.

**Verification:** Acceptance check to add and run, not an executed test: open a form containing `Input.CommandPalette.FilePath`, edit or browse to a path different from its initial value, switch the control's requested theme between light and dark, and verify that the edited path remains displayed and is submitted unchanged. Include an incomplete/invalid edit to ensure preservation is not gated on successful submit validation. The finding is established by the source-level value/reset/reconstruction path; this theme-switch interaction has not been runtime-reproduced.
